title: A visible session's transcript tail stays uncertified on a healthy stream, so the UI re-reads it every ~3 s
outcome: A visible session's tail becomes certified after a successful tail read on a healthy stream, so the tail backstop goes quiet. When it can't certify, the reason is named.
acceptance: The cause is diagnosed live on the running build: which visible session's tail stays uncertified, why needsTailRead keeps holding for it while /api/events?stateDiff=1 is open and confirmed, and whether its reads fail, return stale data, or succeed without certifying. It is recorded in a note with the evidence.
If it is a defect, the fix makes that tail certify, and a Vitest test reproduces the stuck case and shows the backstop going quiet after the fix. The fix lands under the standing rule.
A post-restart observation on the installed build shows no repeating GET /api/sessions/{id}?tail=N for a visible, settled session while the stream is open.
